index_performance.description: Calculates index returns over the past 3 months.
index_performance.query: SELECT index_symbol, (last_close/first_close - 1) * 100 AS index_returns FROM (SELECT index_symbol, FIRST_VALUE(close) OVER (PARTITION BY index_symbol ORDER BY trade_date) AS first_close, LAST_VALUE(close) OVER (PARTITION BY index_symbol ORDER BY trade_date RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_close FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months')) AS index_data;

leading_sectors.description: Identifies the top 5 sectors with the highest average stage scores.
leading_sectors.query: SELECT sector, AVG(stage_score) AS avg_stage_score FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) GROUP BY sector ORDER BY avg_stage_score DESC LIMIT 5;
